MedivhTransformRavenWindsOfCelerity.name: Winds of Celerity
MedivhTransformRavenWindsOfCelerity.description: Increases Raven Form's Movement Speed bonus by 50%.

MedivhTransformRavenRavensIntellect.name: Raven's Intellect
MedivhTransformRavenRavensIntellect.description: Raven Form increases Medivh's Mana and Health Regeneration by 75%.

MedivhPortalPortalMastery.name: Portal Mastery
MedivhPortalPortalMastery.description: Medivh can manually place both Portal locations and it no longer breaks Raven Form. Activate Medivh's Trait to cancel an unlinked Portal.

MedivhPortalMageArmor.name: Mage Armor
MedivhPortalMageArmor.description: The first time an ally uses a Portal, they gain 30 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing their damage taken by 30%.

MedivhPortalRavenFamiliar.name: Raven Familiar
MedivhPortalRavenFamiliar.description: A Raven Familiar joins allies each time they use a Portal. The Raven will dive at the ally's next Basic Attack against a Hero within 5 seconds, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

MedivhDustOfAppearance.name: Dust of Appearance
MedivhDustOfAppearance.description: Activate to greatly increase sight range for 5 seconds and reveal enemy Heroes in the area for 8 seconds. Does not cancel Raven Form. Passive: Increase Medivh's sight range while in Raven Form by 25%.

MedivhMysticAssault.name: Mystic Assault
MedivhMysticAssault.description: If Arcane Rift hits an enemy Hero, Medivh's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 50% more damage and heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

MedivhForceOfWillArcaneExplosion.name: Arcane Explosion
MedivhForceOfWillArcaneExplosion.description: When Force of Will expires, it deals 80 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, plus 50% of the damage it prevented, up to 315 (+4% per level) additional damage.

MedivhForceofMagic.name: Force of Magic
MedivhForceofMagic.description: Preventing at least 268 (+4% per level) damage with a single cast of Force of Will grants 30% Spell Power for 15 seconds. Stacks up to 2 times.

MedivhPolyBomb.name: Poly Bomb
MedivhPolyBomb.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

MedivhLeyLineSeal.name: Ley Line Seal
MedivhLeyLineSeal.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

MedivhForceOfWillCircleOfProtection.name: Circle of Protection
MedivhForceOfWillCircleOfProtection.description: Force of Will also applies to allies near the target, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

MedivhForceOfWillEnduringWill.name: Enduring Will
MedivhForceOfWillEnduringWill.description: Preventing at least 268 (+4% per level) damage with Force of Will reduces its cooldown to 4 seconds.

MedivhForceOfWillReabsorption.name: Reabsorption
MedivhForceOfWillReabsorption.description: Increase the amount of healing from Force of Will to 70% of the damage it absorbed.

MedivhArcaneRiftArcaneCharge.name: Arcane Charge
MedivhArcaneRiftArcaneCharge.description: When Arcane Rift damages an enemy Hero, the next Arcane Rift deals 15% more damage.

MedivhTemporalFlux.name: Temporal Flux
MedivhTemporalFlux.description: Basic Attacks reduce Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 3%. Each enemy Hero hit by Arcane Rift reduces Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 9%.

MedivhPortalStablePortal.name: Stable Portal
MedivhPortalStablePortal.description: Decrease Portal cooldown by 25% and increase Portal duration by 50%.

MedivhPolyBombGlyphOfPolyBomb.name: Glyph Of Poly Bomb
MedivhPolyBombGlyphOfPolyBomb.description: Poly Bomb explodes 1 second sooner and the spread radius is increased by 25%.

MedivhLeyLineSealMedivhCheats.name: Medivh Cheats!
MedivhLeyLineSealMedivhCheats.description: Increase the duration of the Time Stop by 33% and gain the ability to redirect the wave once while it's active.

MedivhArcaneRiftGuardianOfTirisfal.name: Guardian of Tirisfal
MedivhArcaneRiftGuardianOfTirisfal.description: Minions and Catapults hit by Arcane Rift are instantly killed.

MedivhArcaneBrilliance.name: Arcane Brilliance
MedivhArcaneBrilliance.description: Activate to instantly restore 200 mana to all nearby allied Heroes and grant them 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

MedivhDustofDisappearance.name: Dust of Disappearance
MedivhDustofDisappearance.description: Stealth an allied Hero for 40 seconds, they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible. Stores up to 2 charges.
